entries.description: Routed analysis to author ai-assignment.md for all 5 sessions
Routed test-generation for new shell slots + RoleMasterGrid filter parameter; merged into MasterDetailExpansionShellTests.cs and new RoleMasterGridTests.cs
Read project-guidance.md, lessons-learned.md, session-set-authoring-guide.md, and ai-led-session-workflow.md
Pre-flight explore: found 4 shell consumers (RoleMasterDetailsTab, OrganizationMasterDetailsTab, DefaultMasksTab, UsersAndRoleAssignmentTab) plus existing MasterDetailExpansionShellTests

Rewrote MasterDetailExpansionShell as MasterDetailExpansionShell<TRow,TEntity,TLink> with all new parameters and slots declared (ShowGrid, ShowAddAction, ShowRowUseAction, AllowLinkOnly, Mode, TargetEditability, ShowLinkData, LinkDataHeading, FilterContent, GridContent, RowUseAction, DetailsContent, LinkDataContent, DetailsActions, CollapsedSummaryContent, SessionSummaryContent plus all callbacks)

Created MasterDetailShellContexts.cs with ShellMode enum, TargetEditability enum, DetailsContext<TEntity>, LinkContext<TLink>, DetailsActionsContext<TEntity,TLink>, SaveRequest<TEntity,TLink>, SaveAndUseResult<TEntity,TLink>

Migrated RoleMasterDetailsTab to full slot pattern: FilterPanel extracted to tab-level FilterContent slot, RoleMasterGrid stripped of FilterPanel and given external Filter parameter, RoleDetailsSection moved to DetailsContent slot

Minimal migration of OrganizationMasterDetailsTab, DefaultMasksTab, UsersAndRoleAssignmentTab: ResultsContent renamed to GridContent with TRow/TEntity/TLink="object" type arguments. RoleMasterDetailsTabTests updated to use tab-level FilterPanel for filter-change simulation.

dotnet build: succeeded (0 errors). dotnet test: 217 Security.Blazor.Tests pass, 305 Security.Tests pass, 43 Components.Tests pass, 16 Reports.Blazor.Tests pass, 27 Api.Tests pass, 6 Testing.Blazor.Tests pass. 5 pre-existing failures in AcmeCoffeeOnline.Web.Tests (TemplateSeedSmokeTests + WorkflowAssetSmokeTests, unrelated to this session).
